text: Section 12 of the Data Protection Act establishes penalties for unauthorized disclosure of personal data. A first offense carries a fine of up to 5000 dollars. Repeat offenses within a two-year period may result in fines up to 20000 dollars and suspension of data-handling licenses.

Section 13 requires that data controllers notify affected individuals within 72 hours of discovering a breach. Failure to notify within this window is treated as a separate violation under Section 12.

Section 20 defines a data controller as any entity that determines the purposes and means of processing personal data. Processors acting solely on documented instructions are not controllers under this Act.
Section 31 grants individuals the right to request deletion of their personal data. Controllers must comply within 30 days unless retention is required by another statute.
